geometry: Exact Kotlin fusion, regions and PCA/t-SNE; fixed source snapshot, unchanged thresholds.
neighbor_sampling: 12 uniform distinct anchors for each rank 1/3/5, among strong local matches with true same-rank neighbors available in all three variants. No reranking to available catalogue. Two 12s positions per track.
region_sampling: Every region with >=5 strong available members: 1 central + 1 lowest final-world cosine margin + 3 uniform; same five at two positions. MUSIC primary, special content separate.
judge: Direct 4-audio neighbor and 5-audio region prompts; greedy BF16 pinned MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct. No captions, names, genres, weights or conditions supplied.
audio: Mono16k PCM16, stripped metadata; 12s centered at30%/65% of song; preserve original gain.
qa_gate: All12 control answers parse, 3/3 exact scores >=3 and >silence, 3/3 equal candidate spreads <=1, 3/3 identical groups >=3, 3/3 silent groups not assessable. Failure blocks winner claims; retain all outputs.
analysis: Average repeated positions within anchor/region first. Neighbor matched differences and per-anchor bootstrap descriptive. Regions equal-region macro plus coverage; random groups diagnostic only, regions unpaired between variants. Order repeats reported. No population accuracy or significance claim.
limits: One personal library; audio only where strong local matches exist. Missing areas excluded and counted, not assumed successful.
Local matches use filename,size,duration; phone audio hashes unavailable.
Model opinion is not human listening; multi-audio qualification and order checks required.
Repeated tracks/regions/anchors not independent. 12s excerpts do not represent full songs.
